item.title: New Bill Passed to Privatise Oil Sector in Venezuela
item.description: Interim Venezuelan president Delcy Rodriguez has passed a new law opening the country’s oil production to privatisation. For the first time in nearly 30 years… The US eased sanctions at the same time. American firms can now sell, buy, refine, and transport crude. Sanctions on production persist for now.
